name: Customer
description: A company that buys freight-forwarding services from us. Created when sales qualifies an inbound lead and lives through the full account lifecycle (prospect → active → churned). One customer places many orders; the account owner is responsible for the relationship.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.description: The customer's trading name as it appears on contracts and invoices. Set at creation; changing it is a rename of the account, not a new record.

attributes.name: email
attributes.label: Primary email
attributes.description: The main operational contact address for the account. Used for order confirmations and account notices.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: Status
attributes.description: Account lifecycle position. Drives pipeline reporting, revenue recognition, and which workflows are available on the record.

values.label: Prospect
values.description: Qualified by sales but has not yet paid a first invoice. Appears in the pipeline; excluded from revenue reporting.

values.label: Active
values.description: Has at least one paid invoice and no churn signal. Counts toward MRR and is eligible for new orders.

values.label: Churned
values.description: No active contract and flagged lost by the account owner. Read-only in most flows; retained for history and win-back.

attributes.name: industry
attributes.label: Industry
attributes.description: The customer's primary industry, used for segmentation and reporting. Free text today; a candidate to promote to an enum once the value set stabilises.

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.label: Annual revenue
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue of the customer's business, captured by sales during qualification. Used to size the account and prioritise coverage. Stored as an exact decimal amount plus currency code.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.label: Account owner
attributes.description: The salesperson responsible for this account. Assigned on creation and reassigned on territory changes; drives 'my accounts' views and notification routing.

attributes.name: is_priority
attributes.label: Priority account
attributes.description: Whether this account is on the strategic priority list — surfaces it in leadership dashboards and raises its SLA. Set by the account owner or sales lead.

attributes.name: shipping_address
attributes.label: Shipping address
attributes.description: The customer's default ship-to address, used to pre-fill new orders. An embedded value object — it has no identity of its own and is replaced wholesale when edited.
